reviews.boundary_analysis: Outbound Retry-After preference is conditional on policy support, with an absolute no-hammering rule. Inbound 429 and useful-delay header guidance is separately registered; no new universal retry or rate-limiter mandate.

Cache outage behavior must be explicitly chosen; permitted stale reads/omitted optional enrichment cannot become false payment success. Catch-cleanup hypothesis U0012 remains distinct: necessary cleanup in replica0180 might entail the cannot-otherwise qualifier, so this boundary review does not promote it to novelty.

Caller cancellation never becomes repeat attempts; incoming cancellation, operation timeout and upstream timeout are distinguished rather than every TaskCanceledException mapping to 504. Union already represents each effect.

All result-affecting dimensions include locale/filter and genuinely user-specific identity. Centralization is triggered by hard-to-maintain duplication, not mandated immediately; user-response isolation includes authorization context. Baseline covers these conditions.

Pre-success invalidation is expressly allowed only with deliberate workflow acceptance, already an uncertain prior claim. No tracked-entity cache across Unit-of-Work boundaries and defined outage behavior are also covered. Existing uncertainty is not a new finding.

Ordinary-services typed-options prescription is stronger than canonical preference and already registered, as is general ValidateOnStart preference. Prior U0005/6/7 table recommendations remain open: Snapshot for per-request changes, Monitor for background watching and named options for multiple same-type configurations are not settled by broad typed-options coverage. Their advisory/example status requires a different strategy.

Lifetime OR explicit invalidation is preserved; avoid-unbounded does not force time-based expiration when another strategy exists. Data-semantics selection dimensions, including source outage, are explicitly covered.

Small private/nested supporting types may remain with their owner; contract exceptions bound suffix guidance. Async-modifier-only silent config differs from Task/ValueTask prose and BF-0020 registers precisely that. Role-revealing names and navigation-triggered subdirectories are also prior claims.
